Compute Age Driver Vector for Daily Modifiers

Source: R/seir.R
dot-compute_age_values.Rd

Internal helper that generates per-day age values used to evaluate age-dependent modifiers in seir().

Usage

.compute_age_values(age_driver, duration, w, thermal_time)

Arguments

age_driver

Character scalar: "day" or "dvs".

duration

Integer simulation length.

w

Weather subset used for simulation; requires TEMP when age_driver = "dvs".

thermal_time

Thermal-time list used by .calculate_dvs() when age_driver = "dvs".

Value

Numeric vector of length duration:

  • day index 0:(duration-1) when age_driver = "day";

  • DVS values on [0, 2] when age_driver = "dvs".

See also

seir(), .calculate_dvs()
